verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Claude Code 'stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests' and integrates with GitHub/GitLab to handle 'the entire workflow—reading issues, writing code, running tests, and submitting PRs.' This is corroborated by GitHub repo mentioning tagging @claude and PR workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the git-staging/PR-opening flow (community evidence covers general code quality/trust issues but not this specific capability).
